mapper.insert: INSERT INTO login_attempt( username, ip_address, fail_count, locked_until, last_attempt_at ) VALUES (#{username}, #{ipAddress}, 1, NULL, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE fail_count = fail_count + 1, locked_until = CASE WHEN fail_count + 1 >= 5 THEN DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL 15 MINUTE) ELSE locked_until END, last_attempt_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
